senses.gloss:
Veṇu in the Atharvaveda^1 and later^2 denotes a ‘reed’ of
bamboo, It is described in the Taittirīya Saṃhitā^3 as
‘hollow’ (su-ṣira). In the Rigveda^4 it occurs only in a
Vālakhilya hymn in a Dānastuti (‘praise of gifts’), where Roth^5
thinks that ‘flutes of reed’ are meant, a sense which Veṇu has
in the later texts. The Kauṣītaki Brāhmaṇa^6 couples Veṇu
with Sasya, stating that they ripen in Vasanta, ‘spring.’
Apparently bamboo reeds are meant.^7

2) Taittirīya Saṃhitā, v. 2, 5, 2;
